title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact! 

 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

 
 We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries

 We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams

 We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities

 
 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

 The role: 

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and grow our Identity, Risk & Fraud Management product lines. This portfolio powers how businesses verify, authenticate, and protect their users and platforms, and includes products such as Number Intelligence, Number Verification SDK, and Brand Impersonation Protection. You will work at the intersection of B2B data services and B2C trust experiences, building products that help enterprises fight fraud, verify identity, and build trust with their end users at scale.

 This is a high-impact role for someone who understands both the technical depth of APIs, SDKs, and data pipelines, and the business dynamics of risk, identity, and compliance in a global, regulated environment.

 What you’ll do:  

 
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for one or more products within Truecaller's Identity, Risk & Fraud Management suite, including Number Intelligence, Number Verification SDK, and Brand Protection

 Partner closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to build and scale APIs, SDKs, and data-driven services that are consumed by enterprise clients and, in turn, power experiences for millions of end consumers

 Translate a deep understanding of fraud patterns, identity risk signals, and alternate data sources into product requirements and prioritized roadmaps

 Work directly with B2B customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand integration needs, technical constraints, and business use cases across industries such as banking, fintech, e-commerce, and telecom

 Define and track success metrics for product performance, adoption, and business impact, and use data to continuously iterate on the product

 Ensure products are designed and operated in line with global data protection and compliance frameworks, including DPDPA and GDPR, working closely with legal, privacy, and security teams

 Represent the voice of the customer and the market internally, staying current on trends in identity verification, fraud prevention, and risk data services

 Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success teams to support go-to-market efforts, positioning, and adoption of new features

 
 What you bring in:  

 
 8-10 years of overall product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping and scaling data or platform products

 B2B platform product experience is a strong plus, along with a good understanding of what it takes to build compelling B2C experiences

 Sound technical knowledge and comfort engaging directly with engineering teams on architecture, data flows, and system design trade-offs

 Deep, hands-on understanding of APIs, SDKs, and third-party integrations, including how enterprise clients evaluate, integrate, and scale on top of them

 Prior experience in the risk and identity management domain is strongly preferred, ideally including work with alternate data services (e.g., telecom data, device signals, behavioral data, or similar non-traditional data sources used for risk and identity decisioning)

 Working knowledge of IT compliance regulations and data protection frameworks such as DPDPA and GDPR, and experience building products that operate within these constraints

 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous problems and data into clear product decisions

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working cross-functionally across engineering, data science, legal, sales, and customer-facing teams

 A degree in a technical, business, or related field

 
 What we offer:  

 We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

 
 A comprehensive compensation package:  Learning and development allowance, voluntary provident fund (VPF) and/or national pension scheme (NPS) tax saving option provided, creche allowance

 Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.

 A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.

 Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 days each quarter, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

 
 Come as you are: 
Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify,  we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you. 

 Sounds like a great opportunity? 

 We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

 We only accept applications in English.

title: Manager - DAU Growth
description:
About the Team
Meesho is the most downloaded e-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product-Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration.
We are building an inspiration feed inside the Meesho app, focused on look-based, trend-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like Fashion, Home, and Beauty. Our team holds the end-to-end responsibility to figure out the supply of engaging content, establish content partnerships, and solve complex discovery and ranking problems to scale daily active users (DAU). We focus on personal growth, high-impact innovation, and thinking 10x.
About the Role
As a Senior Manager for the Content Commerce team, you will be the driving force behind how millions of users organically discover trends and find personal inspiration on Meesho. This is a 0-to-1 charter where you will solve the dual challenge of Content Supply and Algorithmic Ranking/Discovery.
You will own user engagement, DAU growth, and content-to-commerce conversion metrics by ensuring our feed surfaces highly relevant, visually stunning, and localized content.
What you will do 
0-to-1 Strategy & Vision: Own the long-term (3Y) and mid-term (6M) strategic planning for the content feed charter, operating with a "Think 10x" mindset.



 
 Content Supply & Partnerships: Figure out and scale the supply of high-quality, trend-based visual content. Establish partnerships with creators, influencers, or content syndicates to seed the platform.



 
 Discovery & Ranking Optimization: Collaborate heavily with Data Science and Product teams to build and refine ranking systems that surface the right looks and trends based on individual user preferences.



 
 Cohort-Based Engagement: Deeply understand different user cohorts across India to curate and personalize feeds, driving higher daily active usage (DAU) and long-term retention.



 
 Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the bridge between Content Creators, Category Marketing, Product, Data Science, and Seller Experience teams to seamlessly turn inspiration into purchasing behavior.
What you will need 
Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 3-5 years of experience in product-led growth, content ecosystem management, or digital discovery platforms.

 Target Background: Prior experience working  or leading trend-based, visual-first platforms or similar content-to-commerce startups is highly preferred.

 Problem-Solving & Grit: Strong analytical aptitude and a proven track record of solving complex, ambiguous discovery and ranking problems.

 Execution Bias: A true hustler with a strong bias for speed and execution, capable of multitasking and tactical delivery in a fast-paced environment.

 Mindset: Passion for "Problem First Solving" (PFS) and the ability to build 0-to-1 scalable business models.

title: business development & partnerships
description:
what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. 
 
You’ll play a pivotal role in leading CRED's partner ecosystem across products, becoming the face of CRED to some of India’s top consumer brands. You will lead high-stakes partnerships, drive product adoption, and enable new growth through strategic merchant alliances. As a core part of the merchant-led growth (mlg) strategy, you’ll shape how millions engage with CRED.
what you’ll own
driving acceptance of CRED payment instruments (upi, credit/affordability) with a sole focus of offering convenience for CRED members

 hunt, build and manage high-impact brand partnerships across categories relevant to CRED members

 drive meaningful member value through differentiated rewards, offers, privileges, and experiences

 work closely with internal cross-functional teams including product, growth, marketing, operations, and design to execute partnership initiatives successfully

 support the integration of rewards and merchant constructs across key product journeys and platform surfaces

 drive day-to-day partner management including execution, campaign launches, reporting, issue resolution, and performance tracking

 identify growth opportunities within existing partnerships and help scale high-performing constructs

 leverage consumer insights, transaction intelligence, and market understanding to identify relevant partnership opportunities

 ensure strong execution quality, partner experience, and member relevance across all initiatives
what we’re looking for
4+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, merchant growth, enterprise sales, category or account management within consumer internet, fintech, commerce, loyalty, or digital businesses

 experience managing and growing brand or merchant partnerships with measurable business outcomes

 understanding of consumer and merchant ecosystems across categories such as fashion, travel, food delivery, lifestyle, entertainment, retail, or digital services

 experience working cross-functionally with teams across product, marketing, operations, growth, analytics, or business functions

 strong ownership mindset with the ability to execute independently in fast-paced and evolving environments

 good business and commercial understanding with the ability to structure mutually valuable partnerships

 strong communication, relationship management, and stakeholder management skills

 comfort working with performance metrics, business data, and consumer insights to drive decisions and optimize outcomes
